blocks.value: UPCET exam has been scrapped and has been replaced by other national-level exams such as CUET, JEE Main and NATA for admission into colleges affiliated with AKTU, MMMUT, and other state universities of Uttar Pradesh.
Postgraduation courses such as MBA , MCA , MTech , MURP, MPharm, MDes and MArch will be offered through the CUET PG exam. Integrated MBA and Intergrated MCA courses will be offered through CUET exam.
What is UPCET 2022?

Known earlier as UPSEE, Uttar Pradesh Combined Entrance Test (UPCET) is a gateway for candidates seeking admission to various professional courses offered at the undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) levels at all affiliated institutes of Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology (MMMUT), Gorakhpur and Harcourt Butler Technical University (HBTU), Kanpur. The exam will be conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA) in the computer-based test mode across various cities.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria
General UPCET 2022/UPSEE Eligibility Criteria

value: Candidates should have passed the qualifying exam from any institution in UP or the parents should have the domicile of Uttar Pradesh.
If the candidates have not passed the qualifying exam from an institution in UP, then they will be required to produce their parent's domicile certificate.
Candidates who do meet the domicile requirements will also be eligible to appear for the exam if they meet the other required criteria.
Candidates in the final year of the qualifying exam or are awaiting results are also eligible to appear for UPCET.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for MCA (Integrated)

value: Candidates should have qualified intermediate examination of U.P. Board or Class 12 level examination or its equivalent with Physics and Mathematics/Statistics/Accountancy as compulsory subjects and one of the optional subjects - Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology/Technical Vocational subjects.
Should have obtained at least 45 percent aggregate (40 percent aggregate in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) in the above subjects taken together.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for BPharm

value: Should have passed (with/without grace) intermediate examination of U.P. Board or Class 12 level examination or its equivalent with Physics and Chemistry as compulsory subjects along with Mathematics/Biology subject.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for BHMCT/BFAD /BFA/B Voc/ BDes/MBA (Integrated)

value: Candidates must have passed (with/without grace) the intermediate examination of the U.P. Board or the Class 12 level examination or its equivalent.
Should have secured a minimum of 45 per cent aggregate (40 per cent aggregate for SC/ST category candidates).

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for MCA in any institution affiliated to AKTU, Lucknow

value: Candidates should have passed BCA/ Bachelor degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent Degree or passed BSc. /BCom/ BA with Mathematics at Class 12 level or at graduation level.
Should have scored a minimum 50 per cent aggregate (45 per cent for SC/ST).

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Eligibility Criteria for BTech Lateral Entry

value: Candidates who have passed (with/without grace) three years Engineering Diploma from an Institution located in UP with minimum 45 percent aggregate (40 percent for SC/ST) OR whose parents (Father or mother) are domicile of Uttar Pradesh and he/she has passed three years Engineering Diploma with minimum 45 percent aggregate (40 percent for SC/ST) recognised by the Board of Technical Education, U.P., in any branch of Engineering (except Agriculture Engg., Pharmacy and Architecture).

Candidates who have passed (with/without grace) three years B.Sc. degree and passed Class 12 with mathematics as one of the subjects from any recognised University; securing minimum 45 per cent aggregate (40 per cent for SC/ST) in aggregate. These candidates shall be considered only after filling the supernumerary seats in this category with the candidates belonging to the Diploma stream.
Admission to the second year of B.Tech (Lateral entry) of HBTU would be governed by the eligibility criteria laid down by HBTU.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Admission Process
Check out the important UPCET 2022 admission process:
UPCET 2022 Admission Process
Step 1: UPCET 2022 application form

Candidates can register online on the official website and fill the UPCET 2022 application form . The application fee is INR 1,300 which is to be paid online through debit/credit card or net banking. While filling up the UPCET application form, candidates can select up to five institutes/colleges to send their scores for admission. UPCET 2022 exam will be held in the computer-based test mode across various cities in India.
Step 2: UPCET 2022 admit card

UPCET 2022 admit cards will be released for the registered candidates a few days before the exam. Candidates must download their UPCET 2022 admit card and take a printout of the same before the exam, as it is a mandatory document. Admit cards can be downloaded till the exam day. To check the UPCET 2022 admit card, the candidates will have to log in using the required credentials. While visiting the exam centre, the candidates will have to present the UPCET admit card along with identity proof.
Step 3: UPCET 2022 exam

UPCET 2022 will be conducted in the computer-based test mode. The test will be conducted in more than 40 test centres across the country. Candidates will have to visit the exam centre to take the exam.
Step 4: UPCET 2022 result

NTA will announce the UPCET 2022 results online. The test takers can check UPCET 2022 result and download the scorecard by entering their login credentials. The scorecards will not be sent to any candidate by post. Candidates can check the result only in online mode. On the basis of the result, UPCET 2022 merit list will be prepared by the authorities. Candidates will be invited for the counselling session based on the merit list.
UPCET 2022 Exam Pattern

Along with the syllabus, the candidates are also advised to check the UPCET 2022 exam pattern . Details of the examination such as mode, duration, type of questions and more can be checked through the UPCET exam pattern. This will allow the candidates to be comfortable with the UPCET/UPSEE 2022 exam and be prepared for it.

blocks.value: UPCET 2022 Syllabus

UPCET 2022 syllabus consists of the topics and subjects that the candidates will have to study for the entrance examination. It is to be noted that the UPCET 2022 syllabus will be different for every course that the candidates have opted for. By knowing the syllabus beforehand, the candidates will be able to know what has to be prepared for the UPCET/UPSEE 2022 exam.
UPCET 2022 Counselling

All candidates who are listed in the merit list will be able to appear for UPCET 2022 counselling. NTA will be conducting the counselling session in online mode. During the counselling session, candidates will be allotted seats in their respective courses and colleges on the basis of merit. UPCET scores will be taken into consideration during allotment. Selected candidates will have to submit their documents and pay the fee for confirmation of admission

blocks.value: How to calculate the UPCET 2021 Scores?

Each correct answer in UPCET 2021 will be awarded four marks. There will be no deduction of marks for an incorrect answer in the exam. There is no provision of negative marking for questions left unanswered in the UPCET exam. However, a record of incorrect answers given by a candidate will be kept separately..

It may be noted that the questions in UPCET 2021 exam contain objective type multiple-choice questions. Candidates have to select only one choice for the correct answer to a question. Candidates who mark more than one answer in a question will not be given any marks for that question.
What is UPCET Inter-se-merit Rule?
In case, two or more candidates score equal marks in UPCET 2021, their rank/ inter-se-merit in the exam will be determined in the following way:

value: Number of incorrect answers: Firstly, candidates who have a lesser number of incorrect answers in the exam will be awarded a higher rank
Marks obtained in different sections of the exam : Secondly, candidates who score more marks in different sections (as mentioned in the table below) of the exam will be placed at higher merit
Marks obtained in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry sections of Paper-I respectively
Marks obtained in Biology, Chemistry, Physics sections of Paper-II respectively
Marks obtained in Drawing Aptitude, Mathematics & Aesthetics Sensitivity sections of Paper-IV respectively
Marks obtained in AG-I, AG-II, AG-III sections of Paper-III respectively
Same as applicable in BTech/ BPharm
Age : Thirdly, candidates who are older in age will be given a higher rank.

blocks.value: Steps to fill UPCET Application Form 2022?
The step-by-step process of filling the UPCET 2022 application form consisted of the following process. Since the application process is over, candidates can check the steps for reference.
UPCET 2022 Application Process
Step 1: Registration

The first step for candidates applying for UPCET 2022 is to register at the official website. At this step, candidates will be asked to fill in their personal details, contact details and choose a password and security pin. Once successfully registered, candidates will be able to use these credentials to log in to the website. UPCET 2022 login credentials will be required by candidates at every stage from filling the application form to checking the seat allotment results.
Step 2: Filling the UPCET 2022 Application Form

To access the UPCET 2022 application form, candidates need to click on the relevant application form link on the official website of the exam. On clicking the link, a new page will open. Candidates need to click on the ‘Apply’ button followed by ‘Click Here to Proceed’. On clicking the button, UPCET 2022 application form will appear on the screen. Details that candidates need to fill on the application form are:

value: Personal details : Candidates need to fill in all personal details such as name, father’s name, mother’s name, date of birth, nationality, gender, parent’s domicile, Aadhar number, address, mobile phone number, email etc.

Qualifying exam details : Here, candidates need to enter details such as the name of the qualifying exam, year of passing, subjects in the qualifying exam, state from where the qualifying exam has been cleared, etc.
Course : Candidates need to select the course(s) for which they are applying.
Test Centre: The preferred test centre has to be selected by the candidates.
Password : After all the details are filled in, candidates need to choose a password, which they need to remember till the admission process is over.

blocks.value: After all details in the application form are filled, candidates can click on ‘Edit’ to make changes to the added information or click ‘Submit’ and review the form. If candidates are satisfied with the details mentioned in the form, they can finally submit it by clicking on the ‘Final Submit’ button. It may be noted that once the form is finally submitted, candidates will not be able to make any changes to the information. After the final submission of the form, an application number will be generated that candidates need to note for future reference.
Step 3: Uploading Photo & Signature

Once the UPCET application form 2022 is submitted, candidates can proceed towards uploading the scanned copies of the required documents. It is not mandatory to upload scanned photographs and signatures or pay the application fee at the same time when filling out the application form. Candidates can do the same later by logging in (using the application number and password) into the portal. Take a look below at the list of documents required for uploading:
Note: Do not upload unclear or blurred photographs or leave any mandatory field in the application form blank. Error-prone or incomplete application forms will be rejected.
